consequence.statement: Compactor CLI flags using the boltdb.shipper.compactor. prefix are no longer recognized and will be ignored; the compactor. prefix must be used instead.
consequence.remediation: Replace all occurrences of --boltdb.shipper.compactor.* CLI flags with their --compactor.* equivalents.

original.statement: Compactor CLI flags with the boltdb.shipper.compactor. prefix are removed; use the compactor. prefix instead.

consequence.statement: Compactor settings passed with `boltdb.shipper.compactor.`-prefixed CLI flags stop being honoured because those flags are removed in 3.0.0.
consequence.remediation: Replace every --boltdb.shipper.compactor.* CLI flag with its --compactor.* equivalent before upgrading.

corrected.statement: In Loki 3.0.0 the compactor CLI flags with the `boltdb.shipper.compactor.` prefix are removed. Values set through them are no longer honoured, and the matching `compactor.`-prefixed flags must be used instead.

decision.reason: [ev-f15092605ae3] says the `boltdb.shipper.compactor.`-prefixed compactor CLI flags are removed and that the `compactor.`-prefixed flags should be used instead. That is a removed or renamed key, so the values set through the old flags are no longer honoured: setting-ignored fits. The proposed statement also says the flags "will be ignored", meaning silently skipped. Neither this excerpt nor the section context ([ev-7b76cb015d7e]) says how a removed flag is handled at startup, so the statement is corrected to say only what the evidence supports.
